name: Erect!
source:
Lilythtia International School is located in Mitsuoka-chou where Kento lives, attracting many students from overseas. He helped out every day at his father's flower shop Florist Ogiwara in the shopping area with the intention of carrying on the family business in the future. One day while he was on an errand, he was assaulted by a beautiful girl who he had seen at the school before. When he woke up in the hospital afterwards, her servant Riel told him that she was Runastia, a succubus 'princess' who has a weak body. She asked him for help since his life force was special and it may be able to cure Runa. After giving it some thought, he decided to transfer to Liliythtia, which was actually a school for succubi. Surrounded by ero classmates, will he be able to graduate from the school without being sucked dry?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/06/06/june-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
莉莉丝缇亚国际学校坐落在健人所居住的三冈町，吸引了许多海外留学生。健人每天都在商业街的父亲花店“荻原花店”帮忙，打算将来继承家业。某天外出办事时，他被一名曾在学校见过的美少女袭击了。在医院醒来后，她的仆人莉艾尔告诉他，那个女孩名叫露娜丝缇雅，是一位体弱多病的梦魔“公主”。莉艾尔请求他帮忙，因为他的生命力很特殊，或许能治愈露娜。经过一番思考，健人决定转入莉莉丝缇亚——实际上这是一所梦魔学校。被一群好色的同学们包围，他能否在被榨干之前顺利毕业呢？

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/06/06/june-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
